version.description:
Passing in Claims to store the userId on any flows adjusting any nodes mutating "Inventory Transaction"

Adjusting any nodes mutating "Inventory Transaction"

Adjust CustomData to handle cases where a user triggered a parent flow that called this flow using ExecuteFlow.

CustomData checks if CLAIMS was passed in at the request node, if not then it uses the claims passed from the users request.

data.transform:
{
  "SUCCESS": false,
  "MESSAGE": "Master Inventory #"
      & $state.context.REQUEST.DATA.number
      & " - Product: "
      & $state.context.LOCAL.master.inventory.edges[0].node.product.name
      & " Not In Request!"
}

{
  "SUCCESS": true,
  "MESSAGE": "Shipment # " 
    & $state.context.LOCAL.line.shipment.number 
    & " completed successfully. "
    & $.totalCount
    & " Inventory moves completed during the operation."
}

/*If any of the items fail, return a failure message */
$not($.hasFailures)

{
  "SUCCESS": false,
  "MESSAGE": "Shipment # " 
    & $state.context.LOCAL.line.shipment.number 
    & " not completed. "
    & $.failureCount
    & " out of " 
    & $.totalCount
    & " Inventory moves failed during the operation."
}
